svg.title: The geoid from GOCO06s
svg.text: Height of the sea-level surface of Earth's gravity field above the GRS80 ellipsoid, from GOCO06s to degree 300.
Low: the Indian Ocean geoid low. High: New Guinea and the North Atlantic.
Equal Earth projection. Coastlines: Natural Earth (public domain). Model: GOCO06s (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5880/ICGEM.2019.002).
